functions.name: search_autocomplete

The search is then restricted to knowledge graph items that fit at the ?search positions in the SPARQL query. This function uses the index type for entities of the given knowledge graph internally if the ?search variable first occurs at the subject or object position, and the index type for properties otherwise.
